title: Merchandise Purchases Returns & Exchanges Terms — Starting a Return and the Return Deadline
content:
## 1. When a unit may be put into return

1.1 A completed Merchandise Purchases unit can be put into return when its return date — the date the return is authorized — is on or before its return deadline. The return is started no later than the return deadline counted from the completed date of the unit.

1.2 **Ordinary deadline.** The ordinary deadline is the completed date plus the class's return window plus the extended return days of the customer's Finch Circle tier held on the return date (as kept by the Finch Circle Loyalty Program), counted in calendar days with the completed date as day 0. A return authorized on the deadline itself is in time. The return window starts at the completed date.

1.3 **Holiday purchases.** For a class that offers the holiday return deadline, a unit whose purchase date falls from the start through the end of the holiday purchase window has as its deadline the later of the ordinary deadline and the holiday return deadline of the following calendar year.

1.4 **After the deadline.** A unit can still be returned only when it is defective, until the completed date plus the class's defective return window, or when it was damaged in transit and the damage was reported within the class's damage report window counted from the completed date. After those, a class that refers late defects to the manufacturer warranty refers the unit there, and no return is started.

1.5 **Final sale and personalised units.** Units sold as final sale, and monogrammed or engraved units, are returned only as defective.

1.6 **Condition and method.** The unit must meet the condition its class requires; a used or damaged unit returned as changed mind or as wrong size or fit is rejected on inspection. The return method must be one the class accepts.

1.7 **Whose act it is.** Starting a return is the customer's own act: the customer authorizes it, a return request is created with the status authorized, and the unit moves to return pending.

1.8 **One return per unit.** The same unit has no other return that is authorized, received or refunded.

1.9 **Even exchange.** An even exchange of the unit for the same item in another size or color is made within the class's exchange window counted from the completed date, on the same terms, without a refund and without a new purchase.

## 2. What the deadline is measured against

The deadline is read from the system record: the completed date on the unit's own purchase record, identified by its purchase record number. What the customer recalls about a delivery or pickup date does not replace that record. The one-return-per-unit condition is likewise read from the return requests on record for that same purchase record.

## 3. Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and figures)

| Completed date (day 0) | Class window | Finch Circle extended return days | Deadline | Return authorized on | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 30 days | none | 31 March | 31 March | Yes — on the deadline |
| 1 March | 30 days | none | 31 March | 1 April | No |
| 1 March | 30 days | 15 days | 15 April | 15 April | Yes |

**Holiday case.** A unit of a 30-day class that offers the holiday deadline, bought on 1 December and completed on 3 December: its ordinary deadline is 2 January; the holiday deadline is 31 January of the following year; the later of the two, 31 January, is its deadline. Bought instead on 26 December, outside the holiday purchase window, the same unit keeps only its ordinary deadline.

**A class without the holiday deadline.** For such a class, a purchase in December keeps only its ordinary deadline.

## 4. Points of judgement

- *Defective after the window:* returnable until the completed date plus the class's defective return window; beyond that, a class that refers late defects to the warranty starts no return.
- *Final sale unit returned as changed mind:* not returnable, since final sale units are returned only as defective.
- *A unit with an earlier return that lapsed or was rejected:* that return is no longer authorized, received or refunded, so condition 1.8 does not stand in the way.
